tasks.task_description: Navigate to https://example.com/form-demo, resize the browser window to 1280x720, and capture an accessibility snapshot of the page. Using the snapshot, locate a form with fields labeled 'Full Name', 'Email', 'Subscription Plan', and 'Newsletter Consent'. Fill in the form with the values: Full Name = 'Alex Rivera', Email = 'alex.rivera@example.com', Subscription Plan = 'Premium', and Newsletter Consent = true. After filling, press the Tab key twice to navigate within the form, then click the 'Submit' button. Wait for the confirmation message 'Thank you for signing up!' to appear. Once confirmed, retrieve all console messages at the 'info' level (including those from before navigation) and save them to 'console_output.txt'. Also, list all network requests made during the session that match the pattern '/api/submit', and extract the full response body of the first such request, saving it to 'response_body.json'. Finally, take a full-page screenshot in PNG format named 'confirmation.png' and close the browser tab.
tasks.fuzzy_description:
I need help completing a sign-up process on a demo form page and collecting specific evidence afterward. Please go to https://example.com/form-demo using a browser window sized to 1280x720, and fill out the form with these exact details:  
- Full Name: Alex Rivera  
- Email: alex.rivera@example.com  
- Subscription Plan: Premium  
- Newsletter Consent: checked  

After filling it in, press the Tab key twice while inside the form, then click the “Submit” button. Wait until the message “Thank you for signing up!” appears on the screen.  

Once that confirmation shows up, I need three things:  
1. All console messages logged at the “info” level (including any from before the page loaded), saved into a file called `console_output.txt`.  
2. A list of every network request made during this session that goes to a URL matching `/api/submit`, plus the full response body from the very first such request—save that body as `response_body.json`.  
3. A full-page screenshot of the confirmation screen in PNG format, named `confirmation.png`.  

After gathering all of this, you can close the tab.
tasks.dependency_analysis: This task requires a strict sequence of actions: (1) browser navigation must occur before any interaction; (2) resizing must happen early to ensure consistent rendering; (3) the accessibility snapshot is needed to identify correct element selectors for form filling; (4) form filling depends on the snapshot output; (5) keyboard navigation (Tab presses) must follow form population; (6) clicking Submit depends on prior steps; (7) waiting for the success message validates submission completion; (8) console messages and network requests are only meaningful after form submission; (9) the network request filter relies on knowing the API endpoint pattern; (10) the response body extraction depends on the request list output; (11) the final screenshot captures the post-submission state; (12) closing the tab is the terminal cleanup step. All tools used belong to the Playwright server, satisfying the requirement to use all active servers.

tasks.task_description: Navigate to https://example.com/form-demo, resize the browser window to 1280x720, and capture an accessibility snapshot of the page. Fill out the form with the following data: name 'Alex Rivera', email 'alex.rivera@example.com', subscribe checkbox checked, and country dropdown set to 'Canada'. Then, hover over the 'Submit' button, press the Tab key twice to simulate keyboard navigation, and click the button. After submission, wait for the confirmation text 'Thank you for your submission!' to appear. Capture a full-page screenshot named 'confirmation.png'. Retrieve all console messages (including errors and warnings) since the beginning of the session and save them to 'console.log'. Finally, list all network requests made during the session (excluding static resources), identify the POST request to '/api/submit-form', and extract its response body. Return a JSON object containing: {"screenshot": "confirmation.png", "console_log": "console.log", "form_response": <response_body>}.
tasks.fuzzy_description: I need to test a form on https://example.com/form-demo. Please open it in a browser window sized to 1280x720 and check how accessible the page is. Then fill out the form with the name "Alex Rivera", email "alex.rivera@example.com", check the subscribe box, and select "Canada" from the country dropdown. After that, hover over the "Submit" button, press Tab twice to mimic keyboard navigation, and click the button. Once the page shows the message "Thank you for your submission!", take a full-page screenshot and save it as "confirmation.png". Also, collect all console messages (errors, warnings, and logs) from the start of the session into a file called "console.log". Finally, find the POST request sent to "/api/submit-form" among all the network activity (skip static files like images or scripts), grab its response body, and give me a JSON with these three pieces: the screenshot filename, the console log filename, and the form’s response data.
